raw: [Subtitle(text="A flash of cognition... in the gloom...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: A flash of cognition... in the gloom...

raw: [Subtitle(text="A consciousness... nearly eaten away by disordered emotion...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: A consciousness... nearly eaten away by disordered emotion...

raw: [Subtitle(text="Unable to perceive... Unable to be perceived...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Unable to perceive... Unable to be perceived...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=-1, xstrength=5, ystrength=8, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=false, block=false)]
The outermost layer of the fortress in the skies above the Shard begins to break apart, its many fragments falling like a rain of iron spilling across the ground.
content: The outermost layer of the fortress in the skies above the Shard begins to break apart, its many fragments falling like a rain of iron spilling across the ground.

raw: The enormous skeleton halts in place, its nerve bundles still wrapped around the airship.
content: The enormous skeleton halts in place, its nerve bundles still wrapped around the airship.

raw: The revenant's final consciousness is dissipating.
content: The revenant's final consciousness is dissipating.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.1, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=false, block=false)]
[Subtitle(text="You promised me that future beyond question, Theresa.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: You promised me that future beyond question, Theresa.

raw: [Subtitle(text="But your followers have become hindrances upon your path.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: But your followers have become hindrances upon your path.

raw: [Subtitle(text="My fellow souls are in disarray from centuries worth of scorching flame.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: My fellow souls are in disarray from centuries worth of scorching flame.

raw: [Subtitle(text="This forge was meant to be my cage, my execution chamber wherein I could slit my own throat.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: This forge was meant to be my cage, my execution chamber wherein I could slit my own throat.

raw: [Subtitle(text="I have not yet paid back the price for betraying my clan!", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I have not yet paid back the price for betraying my clan!

raw: [Subtitle(text="This is the last thing I can do, Theresa...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: This is the last thing I can do, Theresa...

content: A violent ignition.

raw: The shadows dissipate from within the inferno, and the flames envelop the airship, tearing apart the nerve bundles.
content: The shadows dissipate from within the inferno, and the flames envelop the airship, tearing apart the nerve bundles.
They charge towards you too.

raw: [Subtitle(text="And as for you all—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="You use false words to place yourselves atop a pedestal of virtue.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: You use false words to place yourselves atop a pedestal of virtue.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Use lies of deliverance to cover the scars Sarkaz inflict on themselves only to survive.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Use lies of deliverance to cover the scars Sarkaz inflict on themselves only to survive.

raw: [Subtitle(text="You dare not even confront her death—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: You dare not even confront her death—

raw: [name="???"]There was no need for you to come here.
content: There was no need for you to come here.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Are you here to look for Amiya? Or perhaps...
speaker: Theresa
content: Are you here to look for Amiya? Or perhaps...

raw: [Decision(options="Are you injured?;Is that child by your side... Amiya?", values="1;2")]
options: Are you injured?;Is that child by your side... Amiya?

speaker: Theresa
content: So that is your answer, Doctor...

raw: You try to step forward, but your body fails to move. You are separated from the scene by an untouchable barrier.
content: You try to step forward, but your body fails to move. You are separated from the scene by an untouchable barrier.

raw: You finally realize that this is not reality.
content: You finally realize that this is not reality.

raw: This is what the revenant has compelled you to see.
content: This is what the revenant has compelled you to see.
A scene of truth.

raw: You see many figures by your side advance.
content: You see many figures by your side advance.

raw: You recognize their weapons and armor. You have seen their shadows before, rather recently in fact...
content: You recognize their weapons and armor. You have seen their shadows before, rather recently in fact...

raw: [Decision(options="Weren't they the apparitions aboard the airship?!", values="1")]
options: Weren't they the apparitions aboard the airship?!

raw: Have they come to protect Theresa?
content: Have they come to protect Theresa?
No, that's not right...

raw: You see them draw their swords against the wounded King of Sarkaz.
content: You see them draw their swords against the wounded King of Sarkaz.

raw: You see a scene that you could never have imagined.
content: You see a scene that you could never have imagined.

raw: Theresa fallen in a pool of blood, protecting the sleeping Amiya in her embrace.
content: Theresa fallen in a pool of blood, protecting the sleeping Amiya in her embrace.
Her murderers surround you.
You and them, conspirators all.

raw: The fleeting scenes melt away, returning your consciousness to reality.
content: The fleeting scenes melt away, returning your consciousness to reality.

raw: You look at W, Kal'tsit and Amiya. You see the expressions on their faces. You realize that you were not the only one watching those visions unfurl.
content: You look at W, Kal'tsit and Amiya. You see the expressions on their faces. You realize that you were not the only one watching those visions unfurl.

raw: The calmness of this dangerous mercenary's expression feels rather strange. You feel as though she should be flying into a rage.
content: The calmness of this dangerous mercenary's expression feels rather strange. You feel as though she should be flying into a rage.
But she does not.

raw: She doesn't even glance at you. Gripping the cannon in her hands tightly instead, she is staring at the revenant's remnant shadows.
content: She doesn't even glance at you. Gripping the cannon in her hands tightly instead, she is staring at the revenant's remnant shadows.
Kal'tsit looks back at you.

raw: Her emerald-green eyes remain calm and collected as ever, but you notice a tinge of sorrow that was not there before.
content: Her emerald-green eyes remain calm and collected as ever, but you notice a tinge of sorrow that was not there before.

raw: Amiya stares ahead blankly in a daze, her arm outstretched, as though trying to grasp something.
content: Amiya stares ahead blankly in a daze, her arm outstretched, as though trying to grasp something.

raw: But all her fingers find purchase on is nothingness.
content: But all her fingers find purchase on is nothingness.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Remain calm, Dr. {@nickname}. I ask that you stand behind me and Mon3tr.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Remain calm, Dr. {@nickname}. I ask that you stand behind me and Mon3tr.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]As I have told you before, I knew what happened in the past, but I had my reasons to keep it from you.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: As I have told you before, I knew what happened in the past, but I had my reasons to keep it from you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I approved of Theresa's choice back then, and telling you as you are now, the truth would not have been of any use.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I approved of Theresa's choice back then, and telling you as you are now, the truth would not have been of any use.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: But...

raw: [Subtitle(text="But Theresa...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="Was it also your choice to allow the revenant to show visions of the past to us, here and now?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Was it also your choice to allow the revenant to show visions of the past to us, here and now?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Doctor...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]It is true that during our time in Chernobog, and even after, I had my doubts about you.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: It is true that during our time in Chernobog, and even after, I had my doubts about you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]But the choices that you have made since are proof enough that you truly do walk the same road as us.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: But the choices that you have made since are proof enough that you truly do walk the same road as us.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Calm down. Do not waver.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Hypocrite.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="Coward—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: W
content: ...Shut up.

raw: [name="W"]How dare you use Theresa to try and sow discord between us.
speaker: W
content: How dare you use Theresa to try and sow discord between us.

speaker: W
content: Just disappear already.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.8, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: W
content: ...Enough.

raw: [name="W"]Kal'tsit, tell your monster to hang back a bit. Wasn't really prepared to do this right now.
speaker: W
content: Kal'tsit, tell your monster to hang back a bit. Wasn't really prepared to do this right now.

raw: [name="W"]I know that old thing's not going to make up some fake movie when he's right about to die.
speaker: W
content: I know that old thing's not going to make up some fake movie when he's right about to die.

raw: [name="W"]I'm not an idiot. There couldn't have been anyone else who murdered Theresa.
speaker: W
content: I'm not an idiot. There couldn't have been anyone else who murdered Theresa.

raw: [name="W"]There must have been an explanation for what happened back then, but killing someone who doesn't remember anything...
speaker: W
content: There must have been an explanation for what happened back then, but killing someone who doesn't remember anything...

speaker: W
content: That doesn't interest me at all.
Surprise. Doubt. Sorrow.

raw: The incomprehensible truth is like a sledgehammer striking at your heart.
content: The incomprehensible truth is like a sledgehammer striking at your heart.

raw: You feel difficult to even begin to recover from the shock. The calm tone of the two before you didn't help you forgive yourself.
content: You feel difficult to even begin to recover from the shock. The calm tone of the two before you didn't help you forgive yourself.

raw: You look at the silent girl, her face streaked with tears.
content: You look at the silent girl, her face streaked with tears.

raw: You want to say something, but she is the one who speaks first.
content: You want to say something, but she is the one who speaks first.

speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor... I knew.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Or rather... I suspected it a long time ago.
speaker: Amiya
content: Or rather... I suspected it a long time ago.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Amiya?

raw: [name="Amiya"]I still remember... why Dr. Kal'tsit had to send the Doctor to Chernobog to heal after the accident.
speaker: Amiya
content: I still remember... why Dr. Kal'tsit had to send the Doctor to Chernobog to heal after the accident.

raw: [name="Amiya"]And the reasons the elite operators gave when they opposed the decision to rescue the Doctor.
speaker: Amiya
content: And the reasons the elite operators gave when they opposed the decision to rescue the Doctor.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Even if everybody was quiet about it, I could still guess. There was only one possibility.
speaker: Amiya
content: Even if everybody was quiet about it, I could still guess. There was only one possibility.

raw: [name="Amiya"]I have guessed, but I still don't understand...
speaker: Amiya
content: I have guessed, but I still don't understand...

raw: [name="Amiya"]The Doctor I knew, the one who saved me, brought me so many different places, told me so many stories...
speaker: Amiya
content: The Doctor I knew, the one who saved me, brought me so many different places, told me so many stories...

raw: [name="Amiya"]The one who brought me back to Babel, the one who tried anything and everything to cure my Oripathy, the one who promised me that I had a future...
speaker: Amiya
content: The one who brought me back to Babel, the one who tried anything and everything to cure my Oripathy, the one who promised me that I had a future...

raw: [name="Amiya"]That incredibly kind person, why did that Doctor... why did that one kill the equally kind Theresa, the person who loved everyone...
speaker: Amiya
content: That incredibly kind person, why did that Doctor... why did that one kill the equally kind Theresa, the person who loved everyone...

raw: [name="Amiya"]I still have so many questions I want to ask you, Doctor.
speaker: Amiya
content: I still have so many questions I want to ask you, Doctor.

raw: [name="Amiya"]The you who rescued me, the you who murdered Theresa, the you who stands before me right now... In the end, which one is the true you, Dr. {@nickname}?
speaker: Amiya
content: The you who rescued me, the you who murdered Theresa, the you who stands before me right now... In the end, which one is the true you, Dr. {@nickname}?

raw: [name="Amiya"]I just didn't know how to ask you...
speaker: Amiya
content: I just didn't know how to ask you...

raw: [name="Amiya"]Since you awoke from the sarcophagus, despite the loss of your memories, you always stood with us no matter the danger... How could I believe someone like this could be a murderer?
speaker: Amiya
content: Since you awoke from the sarcophagus, despite the loss of your memories, you always stood with us no matter the danger... How could I believe someone like this could be a murderer?

raw: You reach a hand out to Amiya.
content: You reach a hand out to Amiya.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=-1, xstrength=8, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor!

raw: The deck of the airship suddenly begins to shake violently. Amiya immediately grabs your hand.
content: The deck of the airship suddenly begins to shake violently. Amiya immediately grabs your hand.

raw: The dark shadows that once gathered within the cabin have begun to bloom in the sky.
content: The dark shadows that once gathered within the cabin have begun to bloom in the sky.

raw: Below the glow of the crimson horizon, a black blossom, dark enough to swallow all light, furled itself around the airship.
content: Below the glow of the crimson horizon, a black blossom, dark enough to swallow all light, furled itself around the airship.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The airship is collapsing.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We must withdraw immediately.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.1, xstrength=8, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Decision(options="—!;Those shadows are trying to block our escape route!", values="1;2")]
options: —!;Those shadows are trying to block our escape route!

speaker: Amiya
content: Stand behind me, Doctor—
'Collapse not in disorder'.

raw: [name="???"]As I speak these words, thus do nature's laws restructure.
content: As I speak these words, thus do nature's laws restructure.

raw: The shadows enshrouding your thoughts are dispersed.
content: The shadows enshrouding your thoughts are dispersed.

raw: Golden incantations break apart the inky blackness, raining down upon the damaged areas of the airship.
content: Golden incantations break apart the inky blackness, raining down upon the damaged areas of the airship.

raw: The words fall apart as they touch the surface before reforming, suturing together the ship's broken body, healing its wounds.
content: The words fall apart as they touch the surface before reforming, suturing together the ship's broken body, healing its wounds.

raw: [name="Logos"]Everyone, allow me to handle the shattered fragments.
speaker: Logos
content: Everyone, allow me to handle the shattered fragments.

raw: [name="Logos"]Pass through the shadow. The skeletal nerves that will ferry us back are ready.
speaker: Logos
content: Pass through the shadow. The skeletal nerves that will ferry us back are ready.

raw: The banshee's bone pen hangs down from his hand, lightly touching upon the surface of the shadow.
content: The banshee's bone pen hangs down from his hand, lightly touching upon the surface of the shadow.

raw: With shadow as parchment, the banshee scribes his incantations with restless flicks of his wrist.
content: With shadow as parchment, the banshee scribes his incantations with restless flicks of his wrist.

raw: Golden veins wend their way through the shadows, as the fires are slowly extinguished.
content: Golden veins wend their way through the shadows, as the fires are slowly extinguished.

speaker: W
content: I can see the nerve bundle!

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We're ready to withdraw, Logos.

speaker: Logos
content: Very well.

speaker: Amiya
content: Hold my hand tight, Doctor—

raw: You all fall back down onto the deck of the airship. The hull beneath your feet continues to shake, but the revenant keeps his silence.
content: You all fall back down onto the deck of the airship. The hull beneath your feet continues to shake, but the revenant keeps his silence.

raw: The shadows circle underneath everyone's feet, as though mocking you.
content: The shadows circle underneath everyone's feet, as though mocking you.

raw: White crystals extrude from the hull, radiating a cleansing light.
content: White crystals extrude from the hull, radiating a cleansing light.

raw: A gentle light. A graceful light. A light that pacifies all confusion, mayhem and disorder.
content: A gentle light. A graceful light. A light that pacifies all confusion, mayhem and disorder.

raw: The rays wash over the shadow, becoming ever more dazzling.
content: The rays wash over the shadow, becoming ever more dazzling.

raw: The purest white erases all color around you.
content: The purest white erases all color around you.

raw: Immediately after, a black hole appears in the distance, devouring the radiance whole.
content: Immediately after, a black hole appears in the distance, devouring the radiance whole.
Darkness. Tranquility.

raw: Amidst the pitch-black dark, a singularity emits its first ray of light.
content: Amidst the pitch-black dark, a singularity emits its first ray of light.

raw: The light of thought. The light of emotion. The light of rebirth.
content: The light of thought. The light of emotion. The light of rebirth.

raw: The ray of weak, reddish light begins to grow and expand.
content: The ray of weak, reddish light begins to grow and expand.

raw: Illuminating the hand that wrought it.
content: Illuminating the hand that wrought it.
Illuminating—

raw: She walks forth from the darkness... No, she has been there all along.
content: She walks forth from the darkness... No, she has been there all along.

raw: It is just that for a moment, she chose to let her gaze fall upon you. For only a moment.
content: It is just that for a moment, she chose to let her gaze fall upon you. For only a moment.

raw: Within her embrace, the revenant's scattered consciousness coalesces once more.
content: Within her embrace, the revenant's scattered consciousness coalesces once more.

raw: All his sorrow. All his misery. All his rage.
content: All his sorrow. All his misery. All his rage.

raw: They dissipate as she consoles him, and at last, the revenant returns to serenity.
content: They dissipate as she consoles him, and at last, the revenant returns to serenity.

raw: She carries her compatriot, abandoned by death as he is. She brings rebirth. She rewrites fate.
content: She carries her compatriot, abandoned by death as he is. She brings rebirth. She rewrites fate.

raw: There is no response, but you manage to glean some curious information from her expression.
content: There is no response, but you manage to glean some curious information from her expression.

raw: You dare not say for sure.
content: You dare not say for sure.

raw: Everyone holds their breath because of her presence. Everyone awaits the first words out of her mouth.
content: Everyone holds their breath because of her presence. Everyone awaits the first words out of her mouth.
Silence.

raw: She says nothing, retreating back into the gloom.
content: She says nothing, retreating back into the gloom.

raw: She leaves no tracks. It is like she were never here.
content: She leaves no tracks. It is like she were never here.

raw: But everyone understands that she has finally taken action.
content: But everyone understands that she has finally taken action.

raw: [name="W"]Did I miss Her Highness say something—
speaker: W
content: Did I miss Her Highness say something—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=4, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="W"]Hey, wait, the airship's moving again?! It's even at full speed!
speaker: W
content: Hey, wait, the airship's moving again?! It's even at full speed!

speaker: W
content: I thought the old fossil was—

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: It is Originium.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]We have gotten too close to Amnannam. The airship is an Originium-rich environment, and its stocks onboard fuel it with energy.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: We have gotten too close to Amnannam. The airship is an Originium-rich environment, and its stocks onboard fuel it with energy.

speaker: Amiya
content: Theresa...?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Ines
content: The nerve connections snapped?

raw: Through the openings in the skeleton, she sees that the great witchcraft-powered construct has already broken free of the nerve bindings, now hurtling at unchasable speeds towards Amnannam hanging in the sky.
content: Through the openings in the skeleton, she sees that the great witchcraft-powered construct has already broken free of the nerve bindings, now hurtling at unchasable speeds towards Amnannam hanging in the sky.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=8, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Ines
content: Hoederer! You're awake?

speaker: Hoederer
content: Emergency landing...

speaker: Ines
content: What did you say?

raw: [name="Hoederer"]The Feranmut... It left a final bit of energy inside the Lifebone.
speaker: Hoederer
content: The Feranmut... It left a final bit of energy inside the Lifebone.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]Perform an emergency landing... in Londinium, somewhere safe...
speaker: Hoederer
content: Perform an emergency landing... in Londinium, somewhere safe...

raw: [name="Ines"]W and the others are still on the airship!
speaker: Ines
content: W and the others are still on the airship!

raw: [name="Hoederer"]I already... promised Dr. Kal'tsit... and the Doctor.
speaker: Hoederer
content: I already... promised Dr. Kal'tsit... and the Doctor.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]To do everything we can... to save more lives.
speaker: Hoederer
content: To do everything we can... to save more lives.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]All we can do... is try our best...
speaker: Hoederer
content: All we can do... is try our best...

speaker: Ines
content: But—

raw: Many have called you by these titles.
content: Many have called you by these titles.

raw: 'The evil spirit of Babel'. 'The Doctor of Rhodes Island'.
content: 'The evil spirit of Babel'. 'The Doctor of Rhodes Island'.

raw: Many have believed in you. Believed that you always make the right decision. That no matter how despairing the circumstances, you would always be able to find a way out.
content: Many have believed in you. Believed that you always make the right decision. That no matter how despairing the circumstances, you would always be able to find a way out.
But—
You are far from omnipotent.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=-1, xstrength=8, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
It all happens in a flash of lightning.
content: It all happens in a flash of lightning.

raw: Theresa does not reappear, having gathered up the shadows and taken them with her.
content: Theresa does not reappear, having gathered up the shadows and taken them with her.

raw: As you approach the Cunabula of Suffering, the crystallization advances ever more rapidly.
content: As you approach the Cunabula of Suffering, the crystallization advances ever more rapidly.

raw: Now that the tides of shadow have retreated, you finally notice that the crystals have covered the entirety of the airship.
content: Now that the tides of shadow have retreated, you finally notice that the crystals have covered the entirety of the airship.

raw: Your companions still stand by your side. They are great fighters all, but in the face of this fated disaster, you are all powerless.
content: Your companions still stand by your side. They are great fighters all, but in the face of this fated disaster, you are all powerless.

raw: The airship, unable to stop, rams into Amnannam—
content: The airship, unable to stop, rams into Amnannam—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.7, xstrength=8, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
And is brought to a standstill.
content: And is brought to a standstill.

raw: The instant that the ship is about to touch Amnannam, the colossal vessel, once hurtling at full speed, is slowed to a crawl.
content: The instant that the ship is about to touch Amnannam, the colossal vessel, once hurtling at full speed, is slowed to a crawl.
Time itself stagnates.

raw: The great Originium tree rapidly grows new limbs, firmly grasping the airship.
content: The great Originium tree rapidly grows new limbs, firmly grasping the airship.

raw: The lush branches quickly extend and envelop the ship.
content: The lush branches quickly extend and envelop the ship.

raw: You see everyone trapped in that moment.
content: You see everyone trapped in that moment.

raw: You see the Originium grow wildly.
content: You see the Originium grow wildly.

raw: You see Amiya anxiously stretch her hand out towards you.
content: You see Amiya anxiously stretch her hand out towards you.

raw: [ImageTween(xFrom=-60, yFrom=-30, xTo=0, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.1, yScaleFrom=1.1, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1, duration=30, block=false)]
This was the moment that time stopped for her. You can even see her shouting your name.
content: This was the moment that time stopped for her. You can even see her shouting your name.

raw: But pure Originium covers her body at a terrifying speed, and the words never manage to leave her mouth.
content: But pure Originium covers her body at a terrifying speed, and the words never manage to leave her mouth.
It spreads.

raw: You rush towards her, but you are nowhere near fast enough.
content: You rush towards her, but you are nowhere near fast enough.
It engulfs.

raw: You see the Originium about to swallow up the final dregs of her body.
content: You see the Originium about to swallow up the final dregs of her body.
Amiya!

raw: You muster all your strength to extend your hand, trying to grab hold of hers... but you are too late.
content: You muster all your strength to extend your hand, trying to grab hold of hers... but you are too late.

raw: You are no longer able to take hold of her hand.
content: You are no longer able to take hold of her hand.

raw: A torrent of jumbled information rushes into your mind.
content: A torrent of jumbled information rushes into your mind.

raw: It is like you are seeing a tranquil world, one completely turned into Originium.
content: It is like you are seeing a tranquil world, one completely turned into Originium.
Amiya... Kal'tsit... Logos... W...

raw: All of Rhodes Island. All of Londinium. All of the battlefield. All of Terra.
content: All of Rhodes Island. All of Londinium. All of the battlefield. All of Terra.

raw: No, this is not what you wanted to see.
content: No, this is not what you wanted to see.

raw: How could you allow all this to happen?
content: How could you allow all this to happen?
Stop. Stop!

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", text="<color=#000000>You did it, Dr. {@nickname}.</color>", x=300, y=350, alignment="center", size=28, delay=0, duration=2, width=700)]
